summary: Recoverable atomic-claim design: CAS claim with stale-claim reclaim (notify_claim_at TTL) so a crashed claim self-heals; confirm-on-delivery, clear-on-failure; session resolved from the reloaded job. Interrogated risks: confirmed-never-reclaimed vs pending-reclaimed-after-TTL; shared-notifier blast radius; TTL bounds.
open_items: TTL must be injectable for tests and bounded (recover promptly vs not reclaim a slow live delivery).
Confirm resume/refresh do not clobber a live claim.
